macroCrosswalk: Gold miners: inflation raises real yields and mine fuel/royalty costs; quality cash return beats raw margin.
Copper: distinguish mine feed scarcity vs refined surplus; AI power/grid is incremental demand, not blank cheque on price.
AI semiconductors: rare earth magnet bottlenecks have tangible factory equipment impact; TSMC substitution also long-run risk to REE intensity.
Existing Malaysian holdings: MSC is tin specialty diversification; no replacement for YTLPOWR/energy holdings risk reviews.
No automatic change to canonical PowerSweep 12-slot selection or single authority Live Desk.
Rare-earth capacity can be subsidized and never realize private shareholder returns if prices normalize.
